description:
HR has provided a list of new employees who need email accounts on the 'acmecorp.test' domain. A CSV file containing their details is located at '/home/ga/Documents/new_hires.csv'.

Your task is to use Virtualmin's 'Batch Create Users' feature to import these users into the 'acmecorp.test' virtual server.

The CSV file includes headers and contains the Email Address, Real Name, and Password for 3 new users. Ensure all users are created successfully with the correct details.
